title: Introduction to Computing
description: Introduces computer systems, digital literacy, and basic computing concepts.

title: Spreadsheet Management
description: Covers spreadsheets, formulas, charts, and business data analysis.

title: Discrete Mathematics
description: Introduces logic, sets, relations, functions, and proof ideas for computing.

title: Systems Analysis and Design
description: Covers requirements, process modelling, data modelling, UML, and system documentation.

title: Structured Programming
description: Develops programming skills using variables, control structures, functions, arrays, structures, and files.

title: Database Design
description: Explores ER diagrams, relational mapping, normalization, SQL, and database implementation.

title: Web Application Development
description: Covers frontend, backend, database connectivity, MVC, authentication, and deployment.

title: Project Management
description: Covers project planning, scheduling, risk, communication, monitoring, and reporting.

title: Final Year Computing Project
description: Students design, build, test, and present a computing solution for a real client or problem.
